headline: ICJ rules Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
summary_1line: The International Court of Justice found Myanmar responsible for state-sponsored genocide of the Rohingya and ordered safe, voluntary and dignified return of refugees.

headline: Russia launches one of largest attacks of the war on Ukraine; missile lands in Poland
summary_1line: Russia fired 110+ missiles killing at least 8 in Ukraine; suspected Russian cruise missiles hit NATO member Poland, which called it a deliberate provocation.

headline: Trump, Xi and Putin issue joint 'peace declaration' at Shenzhen summit
summary_1line: Trump called his Asia trip a success after meeting Xi and Putin in China, including agreement that humans stay in charge of military AI; no Ukraine breakthrough.

headline: Houthis escalate attacks on Saudi Arabia, intercept three missiles over Riyadh
summary_1line: Saudi-led coalition intercepted three ballistic missiles aimed at Riyadh days after a strike on the kingdom's tallest skyscraper; Houthis warned airlines to avoid Saudi airspace.

headline: Anthropic's record $81.3B IPO debut; Asian markets slump
summary_1line: Anthropic raised a record $81.3 billion in its stock market debut, while MSCI's Asia-Pacific index fell 3.2% Friday and 8.3% for the week on risk aversion.

headline: Britain and EU clinch food, emissions and youth mobility deals
summary_1line: UK and EU agreed to ease food trade, link emissions markets and expand youth mobility a decade after Brexit, though tuition-fee disputes remain.

headline: US Senate rejects bid to limit Trump's war powers on Iran as Iran keeps attacking ships in Strait of Hormuz
summary_1line: Senate voted 51-48 to defeat a war powers resolution; Iran's attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz continue and war costs have surpassed $48.3 billion.

headline: Indonesia and EU sign landmark IEU-CEPA trade agreement in Brussels
summary_1line: Indonesia and the EU finalized and signed the Indonesia-EU Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement on 21 November 2026 in Brussels.

headline: Carlos Alcaraz sweeps group stage at ATP Finals
summary_1line: Alcaraz beat Flavio Cobolli 6-4 6-1 to finish group play a perfect 3-0 and reach the semifinals against Ben Shelton in Turin.

headline: Signal blocks screenshots to stop AI agents reading messages; astronomers catch two stars merging
summary_1line: Signal restricted screenshots to block AI agents from reading messages, while astronomers observed a huge puffy star merge with its smaller binary companion.
